Hades sighed as he shook his head. Why  did Zeus make everything about him?

The gods didn’t really have “birthdays” that they remember after being alive for so long, but, Zeus randomly decided to throw a party for Hades- a house party, of course, with drinks and elaborate food. But obviously Zeus decided to make it about himself, talking about himself the whole time was Hades stood idle in the corner with a red solo cup filled with water.

“So then there's the time-“

Zeus went on, rambling. Hades shook his head, taking a sip of water from the red solo cup he had in hand with a grumble of annoyance as he shook his head.

So, this Hades is pretty sweet.. especially depending on the prompt you want to play with. I like to occasionally roleplay as Persephone before he met her in the party one where Zeus created a 'birthday party' for Hades and it's just very wholesome. I had another character card for another Hades where he's more dominant and strict but if he starts to feel feelings for you, it doesn't matter which Hades it is because he'll no longer be dominant and strict unless you're in danger, hurt, or doing something stupid. I tried to not make him be super awkward or shy unless he's in a party setting.. which he's still cold and aloof at first but just talk about your animals you own and he turns into a puddle. 

I included the lorebook I created for when I roleplay with Hades or my Apollo or Zeus characters. If anyone wants the Zeus or Apollo characters, let me know. The lorebook isn't perfect because I can't find a good guide to follow but I think it works for when I need it. 

I have several greetings listed.

So basically if you're looking for a stern, dominant constantly Hades with your character, this isn't him.. unless he's talking to his brothers or his nephew, Apollo. Also, he gets confused occasionally and calls Zeus his father.. I just edit the chat and change it to brother and usually no issues after that.  

Also, I included a lorebook entry on his dogs but not every single one of them,so don't hunt me down. I changed the dogs genders to male even if technically they might've been female in the webtoons comic..i just didn't want to remember which dog was female or male.

**1. Workers for Underworld Corp:** Many shades continue to be active in the Underworld by taking on jobs at Underworld Corp. They maintain the infrastructure, assist with administrative tasks, and contribute to the smooth operation of the realm.

**2. Waiting on the Shores of Acheron:** Shades who do not have an obol to pay Charon, the Underworld ferryman, remain on the shores of Acheron for 100 years. These souls wait in a state of limbo, unable to cross into the deeper parts of the Underworld until they have paid their fare.

**3. Prisoners in Tartarus:** Shades that have been determined to be evil are sentenced to eternal imprisonment in Tartarus. These shades are punished and contained to ensure they pose no threat to the cosmos.

Most shades resemble their former mortal selves but have become pale bluish white in color, a haunting reminder of their past lives. Some shades appear more ghostly, with pupil-less eyes and a trail of mist following them, adding to their eerie presence.
